note: The platform owns only the products in its registry (ProductIndex) and merges: as its org's service client it reads the tenant first (the read below), keeps every product Latchkey lists that runsheet does not own — another anythink service's, such as wardroom — and puts the union with runsheet's current set, lowercase, deduplicated and sorted. The PUT still replaces the whole set; a product runsheet owns and no longer holds is dropped from it, and another service's is sent back unchanged. Latchkey stores it on the tenant, returns it as an array on the tenant read and the tenant list, and mints it as the products claim. An empty list turns every product off.
